essence: Images of the directional deities in goddess form must be established in the sanctuary.
One should arrange either a bull or a lion in the corners of the temple structure.
The consecration of the temple is declared to be a consecration.
One should arrange the enclosure attendants and pavilions and other such structures.
The list includes Śrī, Durgā, Earth, Moon, Gāyatrī, and Dawn.
